# mimir_tenant_limits (Data Source)

The effective limits of a tenant, as returned by Mimir's /api/v1/user_limits endpoint: the tenant's runtime overrides merged over the defaults. Mimir only serves this endpoint when it runs with -runtime-config.file. The request goes to alertmanager_uri, or uri when it is unset, since the endpoint is served at the root of every Mimir component.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimir_tenant_limits" "mytenant" {
  org_id = "mytenant"
}

output "max_series" {
  value = data.mimir_tenant_limits.mytenant.max_global_series_per_user
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) The Organization ID. If not set, the Org ID defined in the provider block will be used.

### Read-Only

- `alertmanager_max_alerts_count` (Number) Maximum number of alerts the tenant's Alertmanager holds. Requires Mimir >= 3.2.0.
- `alertmanager_max_dispatcher_aggregation_groups` (Number) Maximum number of alert aggregation groups in the tenant's Alertmanager dispatcher. Requires Mimir >= 3.2.0.
- `alertmanager_max_templates_count` (Number) Maximum number of templates in the tenant's Alertmanager configuration. Requires Mimir >= 3.2.0.
- `alertmanager_notification_rate_limit` (Number) Per-tenant rate limit for sending notifications, in notifications per second. Requires Mimir >= 3.2.0.
- `compactor_blocks_retention_period_seconds` (Number) Retention of the tenant's blocks, in seconds. 0 means no retention limit.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ingestion_burst_factor` (Number) Per-tenant burst factor, multiplied by the ingestion rate to give the burst size.
- `ingestion_burst_size` (Number) Per-tenant allowed ingestion burst size, in samples.
- `ingestion_rate` (Number) Per-tenant ingestion rate limit, in samples per second.
- `max_fetched_chunk_bytes_per_query` (Number) Maximum size of the chunks a single query may fetch, in bytes.
- `max_fetched_chunks_per_query` (Number) Maximum number of chunks a single query may fetch.
- `max_fetched_series_per_query` (Number) Maximum number of series a single query may fetch.
- `max_global_exemplars_per_user` (Number) Maximum number of in-memory exemplars per tenant, across the cluster.
- `max_global_series_per_metric` (Number) Maximum number of in-memory series per metric name, across the cluster.
- `max_global_series_per_user` (Number) Maximum number of in-memory series per tenant, across the cluster.
- `ruler_max_rule_groups_per_tenant` (Number) Maximum number of rule groups per tenant.
- `ruler_max_rules_per_rule_group` (Number) Maximum number of rules per rule group.
